description: This Java class 'EmailTemplatesUtils' provides utility methods for composing and sending various email notifications within an e-commerce application, such as order confirmations, registration, contact inquiries, order status updates, download instructions, and password change notifications.

classes.name: EmailTemplatesUtils
classes.description: A utility component class providing methods for composing and sending various email notifications related to customer orders, registration, contact, order status updates, downloads, and password changes within the sales management system.

methods.name: sendOrderEmail
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an order confirmation email to a customer after a purchase, including addresses, order details, and totals.

methods.name: sendRegistrationEmail
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a welcome email to a new customer upon registration, containing account and access information.

methods.name: sendContactEmail
methods.description: Sends an email to the store email address with information from a customer contact form submission.

methods.name: sendUpdateOrderStatusEmail
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an email notifying a customer of a change in their order status, including status and comments.

methods.name: sendOrderDownloadEmail
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an email with download instructions for a purchased order.

methods.name: changePasswordNotificationEmail
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a notification email to a customer when their password is changed.
